**IMPORTANT:** For critical vulnerabilities, please follow the process in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/anhhung04/ofx/blob/master/SECURITY.md)

## Description

Brief description of the potential vulnerability.

## Impact

What is the potential security impact? (e.g., template sandbox bypass, secret leakage)

## Affected Versions

Which OFX versions are affected?

## Proof of Concept

If applicable, provide a minimal PoC that demonstrates the issue.

## Mitigation Suggestion

If you have a suggested fix, describe it here.
